column3: “Insult” is rendered “rejection,” and “for giving birth” as “to deliver.”
“The king of Lair” is read as “the king of the city of.”
NASB adds “are God,” following the parallel reading (2 Kgs 19:19).
“Short of hand” is rendered “short of strength,” and “a field before standing” as “scorched before it is grown,” following the parallel reading.
